title: Glowing lighthouse
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- sky glow -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='22' r='26' fill='#1a2a4a' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- light beam left -->
  <polygon points='38,26 5,10 10,20 38,32' fill='#FFE066' opacity='0.35'/>
  <!-- light beam right -->
  <polygon points='62,26 95,10 90,20 62,32' fill='#FFE066' opacity='0.35'/>
  <!-- lighthouse base / rock -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='28' ry='10' fill='#4a5568'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='86' rx='24' ry='8' fill='#5a6a80'/>
  <!-- lighthouse tower -->
  <polygon points='38,84 42,36 58,36 62,84' fill='#E8E8F0'/>
  <!-- red stripes -->
  <polygon points='39,78 40.5,62 59.5,62 61,78' fill='#E84545'/>
  <polygon points='41,54 42,38 58,38 59,54' fill='#E84545'/>
  <!-- tower shading -->
  <polygon points='38,84 42,36 46,36 42,84' fill='#C8C8D8' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- gallery / balcony -->
  <rect x='36' y='32' width='28' height='5' rx='1' fill='#5a6a80'/>
  <!-- railing -->
  <line x1='37' y1='32' x2='37' y2='27' stroke='#8a9ab0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='41' y1='32' x2='41' y2='27' stroke='#8a9ab0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='45' y1='32' x2='45' y2='27' stroke='#8a9ab0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='55' y1='32' x2='55' y2='27' stroke='#8a9ab0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='59' y1='32' x2='59' y2='27' stroke='#8a9ab0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='63' y1='32' x2='63' y2='27' stroke='#8a9ab0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='36' y1='27' x2='64' y2='27' stroke='#8a9ab0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- lantern room -->
  <rect x='42' y='16' width='16' height='12' rx='1' fill='#FFE066'/>
  <!-- lantern glass shine -->
  <rect x='44' y='18' width='5' height='8' rx='1' fill='#FFF5B0' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- lantern frame -->
  <rect x='49' y='16' width='2' height='12' fill='#C8960C'/>
  <rect x='42' y='21' width='16' height='1.5' fill='#C8960C'/>
  <rect x='42' y='16' width='16' height='1.5' fill='#C8960C'/>
  <!-- roof -->
  <polygon points='38,16 50,6 62,16' fill='#E84545'/>
  <polygon points='38,16 50,6 50,16' fill='#C83535' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- roof tip ball -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='6' r='2' fill='#FFE066'/>
  <!-- glowing light core -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='22' r='4' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='22' r='7' fill='#FFF5B0' opacity='0.4'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='22' r='11' fill='#FFE066' opacity='0.2'/>
  <!-- door -->
  <rect x='47' y='72' width='6' height='12' rx='3' fill='#5a3a2a'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='78' r='0.8' fill='#FFE066'/>
  <!-- window -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='3' fill='#FFE066'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='1.5' fill='#FFF5B0'/>
  <!-- stars -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='15' r='1.2' fill='#FFF5B0'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='12' r='1.2' fill='#FFF5B0'/>
  <circle cx='85' cy='30' r='1' fill='#FFF5B0'/>
  <circle cx='12' cy='38' r='1' fill='#FFF5B0'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='8' r='0.8' fill='#FFF5B0'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='40' r='0.9' fill='#FFF5B0'/>
</svg>
